The "vat" name test mirrors the app's own #} {# _is_vat_tax_row heuristic in nepal_compliance_settings.py. #} {# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #} {%- set nst = namespace(rate=0, inclusive=0, found=false) -%} {%- for t in doc.taxes -%} {%- if not nst.found and t.rate and t.account_head and "vat" in t.account_head|lower -%} {%- set nst.rate = t.rate -%} {%- set nst.inclusive = t.included_in_print_rate -%} {%- set nst.found = true -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- if not nst.found -%} {%- for t in doc.taxes -%} {%- if not nst.found and t.rate -%} {%- set nst.rate = t.rate -%} {%- set nst.inclusive = t.included_in_print_rate -%} {%- set nst.found = true -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- endif -%} {%- set vat_rate = nst.rate or 13 -%} {%- set inclusive = nst.inclusive and 1 or 0 -%} {%- set vat_divisor = (1.0 + vat_rate / 100.0) if inclusive else 1.0 -%} {# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #} {# Stored Taxable Summary fields are the single source of truth. #} {# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #} {%- set has_summary = (doc.taxable_amount is not none) or (doc.non_taxable_amount is not none) -%} {%- set taxable_amount = abs(doc.taxable_amount or 0) -%} {%- set nontaxable_amount = abs(doc.non_taxable_amount or 0) -%} {%- set vat_amount = abs(doc.vat_amount or 0) -%} {%- set grand_total = abs(doc.summary_grand_total or doc.rounded_total or doc.grand_total or 0) -%} {# Only the taxable share of the discount is shown as a discount. The #} {# non-taxable share is absorbed into the non-taxable item rates below. #} {%- set nsd = namespace(taxable_discount=0) -%} {%- for item in doc.items -%} {%- if not item.is_nontaxable_item -%} {%- set gross = (item.discount_amount or 0) * abs(item.qty or 0) + abs(item.distributed_discount_amount or 0) -%} {%- set nsd.taxable_discount = nsd.taxable_discount + gross / vat_divisor -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- set taxable_discount = nsd.taxable_discount -%} {%- set subtotal = taxable_amount + nontaxable_amount + taxable_discount -%} {# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #} {# Reconciliation. A rounded grand total is not an error. #} {# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #} {%- set parts_sum = taxable_amount + nontaxable_amount + vat_amount -%} {%- set nsv = namespace(total_ok=false, vat_ok=true) -%} {%- set allowed_totals = [grand_total, abs(doc.rounded_total or 0), grand_total|round(0)] -%} {%- for allowed in allowed_totals -%} {%- if allowed and (parts_sum - allowed)|abs < 0.011 -%}{%- set nsv.total_ok = true -%}{%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- if (parts_sum|round(0) - grand_total|round(0))|abs < 0.011 -%}{%- set nsv.total_ok = true -%}{%- endif -%} {%- set expected_vat = taxable_amount * vat_rate / 100.0 -%} {%- if (vat_amount - expected_vat)|abs >= 0.011 -%}{%- set nsv.vat_ok = false -%}{%- endif -%} {%- set reasons = [] -%} {%- if has_summary and not nsv.total_ok -%} {%- set reasons = reasons + [ "Taxable + Non-Taxable + VAT = " ~ "{:,.2f}".format(parts_sum) ~ " does not match the Total of " ~ "{:,.2f}".format(grand_total) ] -%} {%- endif -%} {%- if has_summary and not nsv.vat_ok -%} {%- set reasons = reasons + [ "VAT of " ~ "{:,.2f}".format(vat_amount) ~ " is not " ~ "{:,.10g}".format(vat_rate) ~ "% of the Taxable Amount (" ~ "{:,.2f}".format(expected_vat) ~ " expected)" ] -%} {%- endif -%} {%- if not has_summary -%} {%- set reasons = reasons + ["Taxable Summary has not been calculated on this invoice"] -%} {%- endif -%} {%- set is_wrong = reasons | length > 0 -%} {%- if doc.docstatus == 0 -%} {%- set titles = ["DRAFT INVOICE"] -%} {%- elif doc.docstatus == 2 -%} {%- set titles = ["CANCELLED INVOICE"] -%} {%- elif is_return -%} {%- set titles = ["CREDIT NOTE"] -%} {%- elif actual_print_count == 0 -%} {%- set titles = ["TAX INVOICE", "INVOICE"] -%} {%- else -%} {%- set titles = ["INVOICE"] -%} {%- endif -%} {%- set company = frappe.get_doc("Company", doc.company) -%} {#- the link_name filter joins Dynamic Link, so order_by columns must be qualified -#} {%- set addr_order = "`tabAddress`.is_primary_address desc, `tabAddress`.modified desc" -%} {%- set address_list = frappe.get_all("Address", filters={"link_name": doc.company, "is_your_company_address": 1}, order_by=addr_order, limit=1) -%} {%- if not address_list -%} {%- set address_list = frappe.get_all("Address", filters={"link_name": doc.company}, order_by=addr_order, limit=1) -%} {%- endif -%} {%- set address_doc = frappe.get_doc("Address", address_list[0].name) if address_list else none -%} {#- doc.in_words is built from rounded_total/grand_total, so it drifts from the Total printed below, and frappe returns an empty string for a negative amount, which left every credit note with a blank Amount in Words.
